verdict.rationale: Bland's docs show strong API/CLI parity for most core workflows — pathways can be created/managed via API (bland-docs-1,19), the CLI claims to manage the 'entire account' (bland-docs-12), and calls, batch campaigns, evals, testbed, memories, and SIP are all documented as API-driven (bland-docs-6,7,8,9,17). The MCP server further exposes calls, pathways, agents, analytics, and evals to any AI agent (bland-docs-34). However, there is no explicit statement that every UI capability (e.g., visual pathway editor drag-and-drop, testbed UI interactions) has a 1:1 API equivalent, and a direct OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, leaving API completeness unconfirmed. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, working OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of full coverage for visual/editor-only features.
